_comment: Single source of truth for deal cards. Edited via chat (direct edits) or /#/admin (GitHub API commit). Schema: { amt, who, type, form, when, summary, pages, preTurnpage }. pages = array of page slugs the deal appears on (home, crypto, ai-copyright). preTurnpage = true shows * after claim type on the card. Change schema → update DealCard.jsx + Admin.jsx + functions/api/admin/deals.js in the same commit.

deals.summary: Advised investor group on resolving disputed ownership of FTX claim arising from post-bankruptcy ponzi scheme in Korea. Assisted with identification and engagement of U.S. bankruptcy counsel, coordinated with Korean advisors and assisted on all aspects of strategy including with respect to Korean bankruptcy matters.

Brokered exclusive sale of minority interest in seized crypto, crypto-backed loans, real estate and other assets held across multiple jurisdictions to a family office buyer. Proceeds used to fund seller's ongoing legal expenses in active DOJ litigation.

Brokered exclusive sale of a rejected licensing agreement claim to a multinational hedge fund group. Structured sale to include contingent consideration for seller based on ultimate allowed amount of claim.

deals.type: Crypto Exchange / Institutional BTC Loan Claim
deals.summary: Brokered exclusive sale of Korean crypto exchange claim against Genesis Global to U.K.-based hedge fund with settlement in BTC.
Brokered exclusive secondary sale of Visa/MasterCard claim to prop desk of U.S.-based investment bank.

deals.type: Dozens of U.S. Importers / IEEPA Tariff Refund Rights
deals.summary: Advised importers on pathways to monetize tariff refund rights arising from the U.S. Supreme Court's decision in Learning Resources v. Trump and subsequent rulings at the Court of International Trade. Arranged multiple transactions to provide immediate cash to sellers and balance counterparty risk.

Brokered sale of multi-employer pension plan claim held by teamsters union to U.S.-based hedge fund. Advised client over many months, navigating volatile market through complex Delaware bankruptcy court litigation and multiple appeals.
Partnered with series of capital providers to offer instant liquidity to college athletes seeking to monetize 10-year structured settlement.
Built marketplace to offer competitive exit options for smaller customer claims on form documents across multiple bankrupt crypto exchanges.
